decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ PATH{ NAME "client" }, SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_policy" VALUE u16=0xFFC1 } } — every reserved bit (8–15) set: MUST be ignored, never rejected; reliability=1 and delivery_class=3 below them still apply (RFC-0022 §5.3, RFC-0025 §4.1 as amended). Same bytes as before the narrowing — RFC-0025 §4.1.2 clause 7 repairs this vector in place
decoded.note: an implementation that rejects unknown bits fails this vector; so does one that lets them leak into reliability, priority or the delivery class
